title: Launch communications playbook and cross-team timeline for Runtime 1.22 public launch
creator: Aisha Menon
description:
Objective: Coordinate a cross-functional announcement for Runtime 1.22 that highlights latency and cost improvements, new quantization profiles, and Dedicated autoscaling controls. Primary channels: blog post, customer email, social (X/LinkedIn), technical webinar, docs & release notes, console banners, and partner enablement.

Scope: Finalize messaging, produce short-form and long-form content, schedule outbound sends, prepare support playbook, update SDK changelog and code samples, and train Solutions/CS on key talking points. Exclusions: Paid media campaigns (handled by Growth), internal infra rollbacks (handled by ENG on separate incident tickets).

Success metrics: 1) Blog views >= 8k in first week, 2) webinar registrants >= 1.2k with 30% attendance, 3) < 1% of API errors attributable to rollout, 4) developer documentation task completion tracked in docs-1.22 board.

Audience segments: existing hosted API customers, Dedicated customers with reserved capacity, platform partners (SIs) and developer community. Messaging variants defined for each segment in the content matrix (Drive doc linked below).
acceptance_criteria: Draft blog post approved by PM + Comms + Legal
Release notes entry merged and SDK changelog updated
Webinar slides + demo recorded and uploaded to Drive
Customer email copy approved and scheduled in HubSpot
Support playbook published and triage runbook loaded into Zendesk article
